name: I want a backsplash installed now — what happens first and how do I get started?
description: Start with a measure and wall check. The installer can confirm tile quantities, surface prep needs, and any outlet cuts before scheduling the work.

mainEntity.name: I want a backsplash installed now — what happens first and how do I get started?

acceptedAnswer.text: A tile backsplash protects the wall behind your sink, stove, and counters from splashes, grease, and stains while also giving the kitchen a finished look. In most homes, the project starts with a site visit so the installer can measure, check wall conditions, and confirm the tile layout.
